caseNameFull: Baird v. Pratt, Commissioner, Department of Public Welfare of Massachusetts and Preterm, Inc. v. King, Governor of Massachusetts

opinions.text: C. A. 1st Cir. Motions of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file briefs as amicus curiae denied. Motions to appoint Alan Ernest as counsel for children unborn and born alive denied. Certio-rari denied.
